Chunk management

Source: R/chunking.R
chunking.Rd

This class implements the basic ancestor for chunking the data of Zarr arrays. It provides the mechanism for chunk access in the Zarr store that is independent of the geometry of the chunk grid: addressing chunks by their grid index through the chunk key encoding, caching chunk I/O objects, raw chunk access and relocating chunks in the store.

The geometry of the chunk grid - how the array is partitioned into chunks along each dimension - is the responsibility of descendant classes. The "regular" chunk grid that is a required component of Zarr v.3 is implemented by the chunk_grid_regular class. Zarr arrays that use sharding are managed by the chunk_grid_sharded class, a descendant of chunk_grid_regular because the sharding codec requires a regular grid of shards. Sharding is treated as a chunking scheme rather than as a codec because it has to do the same topological operations as a regular chunk manager to map a user request for data to ranges across multiple chunks (and shards) and then apply the set of codecs that apply. These codecs for sharded data are embedded in the sharding configuration.

A descendant class must set the private field .grid and implement the private method max_chunk_length() and the public methods resize(), read() and, if supported, write().

There is no point instantiating this class directly, other than in the initialize() method of a descendant class.

Super class

zarr_extension -> chunking

Active bindings

array_shape

(read-only) The shape of the array, NULL for a scalar array.

grid

(read-only) The number of chunks along each dimension of the array. This is an empty integer vector for a scalar array.

chunk_encoding

Set or retrieve the chunk key encoding to be used for creating store keys for chunks.

data_type

The data type of the array using the chunking scheme. This is set by the array when starting to use chunking for file I/O.

store

The store of the array using the chunking scheme. This is set by the array when starting to use chunking for file I/O.

array_prefix

The prefix of the array using the chunking scheme. This is set by the array when starting to use chunking for file I/O.

chunking$new()

Initialize a new chunking scheme for an array. This should only be called by descendant classes, which must also set the grid of chunks of a non-scalar array.

Usage

chunking$new(class_name, array_shape)

Arguments

class_name

Character string given the name of the chunking scheme.

array_shape

Integer vector of the array dimensions. This may be NA for a scalar array.

Returns

An instance of chunking.

chunking$resize()

Resize the array by growing or shrinking any combination of dimensions at either end, updating the chunks in the store accordingly. How a requested change maps onto the chunk grid is determined by the descendant class.

Usage

chunking$resize(low, high)

Arguments

low, high

Integer vectors, one element per array dimension, with the requested change in extent at the low and high end of each dimension. Positive grows that end, negative shrinks it.

Returns

Self, invisibly.

chunking$insert_dimension()

Move the chunks in the store to the grid of an array whose rank is one higher, by inserting a new dimension that holds exactly one chunk. A scalar array has its single chunk moved to the first chunk of a rank-1 grid. Chunk payload is never touched. The chunking scheme itself is not updated: the caller must create a new chunking scheme for the promoted array.

Usage

chunking$insert_dimension(dimension)

Arguments

dimension

Integer, the 1-based position of the new dimension in the grid of the promoted array.

Returns

Self, invisibly.

chunking$chunk_keys()

Generate the keys of all chunks in the chunk grid, or of all shards for a sharded array. Keys are derived from the grid and the chunk key encoding, not by listing the store, so this works for stores that cannot list their keys. Chunks need not exist in the store.

Usage

chunking$chunk_keys()

Returns

A character vector of chunk keys, relative to the array prefix.

chunking$read_raw()

Read the bytes of a chunk (or shard) as they are held in the store, without decoding. Any pending edits to the chunk are flushed to the store first.

Usage

chunking$read_raw(key)

Arguments

key

Chunk key relative to the array prefix, as produced by chunk_keys().

Returns

A raw vector, or NULL if the chunk is not present in the store.

chunking$write_raw()

Write the bytes of a chunk (or shard) to the store, without encoding. Any cached copy of the chunk is dropped. The caller is responsible for value being consistent with the codecs of the array.

Usage

chunking$write_raw(key, value)

Arguments

key

Chunk key relative to the array prefix, as produced by chunk_keys().

value

A raw vector with the encoded chunk.

Returns

Self, invisibly.

chunking$flush()

Persist the data in all chunks with pending edits to the store. This base implementation is a no-op for chunking schemes that do not buffer writes.

Usage

chunking$flush()

Returns

Self, invisibly.
